cues.headline: Harbor City are on top
cues.body: Harbor City have taken over: they've had the ball 62% of the time in the last 5 minutes. Just what Harbor City need while they're behind.

cues.headline: Harbor City have taken over
cues.body: The game is going Harbor City's way: winning 100% of the duels near the opposition box, recovering the ball 3 times in the final third and going long with 15% of their passes in the last 5 minutes. Harbor City are already ahead, and still pushing.

recap.headline: Full time: Elmstead Wanderers 4–5 Harbor City
recap.summary: A deserved win for Harbor City.
